sum: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares. detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE on or around 19 June 2026 in compliance with SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) mandates public disclosure when a person or group crosses 5% of voting capital. No corroborating company press release, exchange announcement of acquisition terms, or acquirer identity could be independently verified from available sources.
